owns: Unambiguous provider-transaction to Forecast-event identity. A match requires an explicit payee alias + mapped Atlas account + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for the named fixed Tennis BC salary streams only — a uniquely proven transfer credit into BILLS (chequing-a) that is independently paired to the TENNIS INCOME salary flow + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation. Optional payeeExcludePatterns refuse a hit that also matches a reimbursement or other excluded alias. Same-day is the default; named automatic payments may opt into weekend-to-next-business-day; a payment onto a mapped card may cover the latest due on or before posting. A covers-due-on-or-before-posting match against a once occurrence is allowed only when the posting is on or before seven calendar days after that due; a later same-alias debit does not reuse that once occurrence. Named Triangle and MBNA card-minimum rules may instead use covers-statement-cycle-or-latest-due: after identity, a payment on or after that card's debts.statementCloseDay may settle the upcoming minimum that statement created, and a later payment may still cover the latest due on or before posting. Statement close days are not copied into this file. Amount similarity is not identity. After that identity is unique, a card extra payment may settle the min only when the observed credit is at least the scheduled due. Named fixed salary streams additionally require the exact scheduled amount as a necessary guard; that amount is not identity by itself. A generic exact-amount BILLS transfer is not salary identity. A TENNIS BC payee credit on a household account is not salary identity. A TENNIS INCOME deposit or reimbursement is not household-cash posting proof. An unrelated household transfer is not salary identity. A refund or merchant credit is not a card-minimum payment. A payment before statement creation does not settle that future minimum. Named mapped-MBNA card-credit rules that claim the literal payee payment require payeeMatchMode exact; a PAYMENT-prefixed reversal, refund, or protection alias is not that identity.
does_not_own: Permission to write plan.opening or representedEvents onto data.json, pending-to-posted proof, or a second event engine.
